taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: numerous erect stems 6-10 dm. high from a woody crown.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems rarely over 1.2 m.

traits.life_span.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: suffrutescent, from a woody crown: a perennial.

traits.woodiness.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 568), Sphaeralcea ambigua: stems woody below; suffrutescent (Abrams 1951 p. 88).

traits.rosette.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: numerous leafy erect stems: no rosette.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: leaves alternate, as in the family.

traits.leaf_division.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: leaves broadly ovate to orbicular, shallowly 3-lobed: simple.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: leaves shallowly 3-lobed; Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 566): blades semiorbicular, shallowly lobed.

traits.leaf_lobes.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: shallowly 3-lobed.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: blades 2 cm to 5 cm long; the length in Abrams (1951 p. 88) is unreadable in the copy read.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: blades about as wide as long, 2 cm to 5 cm.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: petioles 1 cm to 3 cm long.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: leaves broadly ovate to orbicular, cordate at base.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: leaves crenate.

traits.leaf_hairs.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: white or yellowish canescent throughout.

traits.hair_branching.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 86, Sphaeralcea: herbage stellate-pubescent, as in the genus.

traits.hair_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: white or yellowish canescent; sRGB by eye from the photos (a pale grey-green felt).

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: inflorescence an open panicle; Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 567): open panicle.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Open flowers 3 cm to 5 cm across (petals 1.5-3.5 cm long in Abrams 1951 p. 88), set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 262643371, 151962086, 18433679, 5422347, 336885570, 260315388, 151654134, 114013056): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.petal_length_m.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 569), Sphaeralcea ambigua: petals up to 3 cm long (Abrams 1951 p. 88: 15-35 mm).

traits.flower_colour.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 569), Sphaeralcea ambigua: petals apricot or grenadine (var. rosacea mauve); sRGB by eye from the photos (apricot orange).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 86, Sphaeralcea: regular flowers.

traits.corolla_shape.note: Petals forming a shallow open cup, set by hand from iNaturalist photos (observations 262643371, 151962086, 18433679, 5422347, 336885570, 260315388, 151654134, 114013056): the sources read give no count or measure.

traits.sepal_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: calyx 6-20 mm. long.

traits.fruit_type.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 86, Sphaeralcea: fruit of several one-seeded carpels, separating at maturity: a schizocarp.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 88, Sphaeralcea ambigua: fruit 6-12 mm. wide.

traits.flowering_months.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 569), Sphaeralcea ambigua: 3,000 feet or lower, February to May (Abrams 1951 p. 88: April to July).

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: fruits ripe from April to June.

traits.elevation_max_m.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 569), Sphaeralcea ambigua: 3,000 feet or lower: about 910 m.

traits.light.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 569), Sphaeralcea ambigua: dry plains and slopes, in the open.

traits.moisture.note: Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 569), Sphaeralcea ambigua: dry plains, mesas and slopes.

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a mound of many erect, grey-felted stems from a woody base, pale grey-green shallowly three-lobed leaves, and open sprays of cupped apricot-orange flowers. Colours set by eye were written as screen (sRGB) shades; they are read as the linear light a colour field holds, and bark and foliage follow the stated colour traits by rule (2026-10-19).

generator.params.note: Set by hand for desert globemallow from its sources and the photos the traits cite, on the template of Cooley's hedge-nettle (stachys-chamissonis); the rest of its growth comes from the library's rules for the form. Not fitted to measurements. The panicle's length is drawn by the hand-set raceme share (0.45 of the stem) and its 14 flowers each on its own stalk; the unsourced inflorescence_length_m estimate (15-40 cm) was removed 2026-10-19, as the herb rule then drew each of the 14 flowers as a whole panicle 27 cm across. Kearney and Peebles (1942, p. 569): "The inflorescence is typically an open, long-branched panicle".

allometry.note: 0.8 m tall at 4 years in the open, within its sources' range, as it grows on a Sonoran Desert bajada. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added for the Saguaro desert scene (west bajada, Tucson Mountain District, 2026-10-19): sizes and forms from FEIS, Kearney and Peebles (1942) and Abrams, counts and colours from iNaturalist photos, drawing values from the library's rules for the form.
